Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the `elif [ "${ANY_FAILED}" = "true" ]; then` delivered-closed branch of the completion-status block.
Evidence of absence: The dedupe is per item (`completion_status_delivered_closed_alerted` holds issue numbers; `$cur - $seen` alerts only new items), but `_csc_delivered_new_refs` joins all newly delivered items into one string such as "#10, #11", and `tg_notify ... Fix: loop over `_csc_delivered_new_json` and call tg_notify once per issue number, or change the agents.d wording to "one WARNING per tick listing each newly delivered item once".

Fix: `assert (result.get("latest_state") or {}).get("judge_last_fingerprint") or (result.get("state_on_disk") or {}).get("judge_last_fingerprint"), case` (estimated 2 lines changed).
